snippet.title: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos is AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description:
Kapow! Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos is out now!

Croc is heading for the mainland to find his long-lost parents. There’s just one problem: the Dantinis have brought Baron Dante back, and the Baron has a score to settle.

The Sailor, Cossack, Caveman, and Inca villages are full of Gobbos waiting to be rescued, and a brand-new crew of Guardians is standing in the way. Croc’s trusty jump and tailspin are back, and now he can triple jump too, for those ledges that always seem just out of reach.

Then things speed up. Tear around in racecars and speedboats, ride the rails on minecarts, catch the breeze on a hang glider, and take a wooden airplane for a spin across more than 40 levels of open-ended 3D platforming.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals, refined controls, and quality-of-life improvements, Croc 2 has never looked or played better.

Want to see how it all came together? Explore the Croc2pedia, a digital museum packed with concept art, animation tests, cut content, and 90 minutes of interviews with members of the original and remaster teams.

Play it on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows PC on Steam and GOG.com.

Jump in today and help Croc rescue all the Gobbos!

https://www.argonautgames.com/croc2remaster

PS5 / PS4: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017913
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/croc-2-kingdom-of-the-gobbos-switch
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/croc-2-kingdom-of-the-gobbos/9MWR2QK58LPQ/0010
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4198360
GOG.com: https://www.gog.com/game/croc_2_kingdom_of_the_gobbos
